verses.translation: A Song of Degrees. In mine affliction I cried to the Lord, and he hearkened to me.

translations.ron: Către Domnul am strigat când m-am necăjit şi m-a auzit.
translations.grk: Ὠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐκέκραξα, καὶ εἰσήκουσέ μου.

verses.translation: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from unjust lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

translations.ron: Doamne, izbăveşte sufletul meu de buzele nedrepte şi de limba vicleană.
translations.grk: Κύριε, ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ χειλέων ἀδίκων καὶ ἀπὸ γλώσσης δολίας.

verses.translation: What should be given to thee, and what should be added to thee, for thy crafty tongue?

translations.ron: Ce se va da ţie şi ce vei câştiga de la limba vicleană?
translations.grk: Τί δοθείη σοι, καὶ τί προστεθείη σοι πρὸς γλῶσσαν δολίαν;

verses.translation: Sharpened weapons of the mighty, with coals of the desert.

translations.ron: Săgeţi ascuţite cu cărbuni aprinşi trase de Cel puternic.
translations.grk: Τὰ βέλη τοῦ δυνατοῦ ἠκονημένα σὺν τοῖς ἄνθραξι τοῖς ἐρημικοῖς.

verses.translation: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged; I have tabernacled among the tents of Kedar.

translations.ron: Vai mie, că pribegia mea s-a prelungit, că locuiesc în corturile lui Chedar!
translations.grk: Οἴμοι ὅτι ἡ παροικία μου ἐμακρύνθη, κατεσκήνωσα μετὰ τῶν σκηνωμάτων Κηδάρ.

verses.translation: My soul has long been a sojourner;

translations.grk: Πολλὰ παρῴκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου· μετὰ τῶν μισούντων τὴν εἰρήνην.

verses.translation: I was peaceable among them that hated peace; when I spoke to them, they warred against me without a cause.

translations.ron: Cu cei ce urau pacea, făcător de pace eram; când grăiam lor, se luptau cu mine în zadar.
translations.grk: Ἤμην εἰρηνικός· ὅταν ἐλάλουν αὐτοῖς, ἐπολέμουν με δωρεάν.
